verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party data export feature, such as CSV, JSON or Markdown workspace export, and nothing about leaving. The GraphQL API ('query and mutate your data') is only a developer building block, and the Fivetran and Airbyte connectors are third-party sync tools, so neither counts as a product-owned export capability. The import tooling runs the opposite direction (into Linear).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
